_source.title: 获取文件夹详细属性
_source.remarks.text.0: 当 {@link IDMT_FolderItem.parentFolderUuid | parentFolderUuid} 等于 {@link IDMT_FolderItem.teamUuid | teamUuid} 时，代表当前文件夹为指定团队下的一级文件夹
_source.returns: 文件夹属性，如若为 `undefined` 则获取失败

title: Get Folder detailed properties
remarks.text.0: When {@link IDMT_FolderItem.parentFolderUuid | parentFolderUuid} equals {@link IDMT_FolderItem.teamUuid | teamUuid}, it means the current folder is a first-level folder under the specified team
returns: Folder property; if it is `undefined`, the retrieval failed
